items.name: Carl 'CJ' Johnson
items.summary: Returns to Los Santos after five years away for his mother's funeral and rebuilds the Grove Street Families.

items.name: Catalina
items.summary: CJ's brief girlfriend in the Badlands; robs stores with him in a series of missions.

items.name: Cesar Vialpando
items.summary: Kendl's boyfriend and leader of the Aztecas; CJ's most reliable ally.

items.name: Denise Robinson
items.summary: Grove Street affiliate and one of CJ's girlfriends.

items.name: Eddie Pulaski
items.summary: Tenpenny's brutal partner, killed by CJ in the desert.

items.name: Frank Tenpenny
items.summary: The primary antagonist, a corrupt cop who manipulates every gang in the state.

items.name: Jimmy Hernandez
items.summary: The youngest C.R.A.S.H. officer, torn between loyalty and doing the right thing.

items.name: Jizzy B
items.summary: Pimp whose club fronts the Loco Syndicate's drug operation.

items.name: Ken Rosenberg
items.summary: Vice City lawyer now managing a Las Venturas casino for the mob.

items.name: Kendl Johnson
items.summary: CJ and Sweet's sister, partner of Cesar Vialpando.

items.name: Kent Paul
items.summary: Lewd music-business fixer encountered in San Fierro and Las Venturas.

items.name: Lance 'Ryder' Wilson
items.summary: Hot-headed Grove member who turns on the family.

items.name: Madd Dogg
items.summary: Famous rapper whose career CJ manages after OG Loc steals his work.

items.name: Melvin 'Big Smoke' Harris
items.summary: CJ's childhood friend whose ambition leads him to betray Grove Street.

items.name: Mike Toreno
items.summary: A shadowy federal agent who blackmails CJ into running missions for him.

items.name: Millie Perkins
items.summary: Casino manager CJ dates to obtain the key card for the Caligula's heist.

items.name: OG Loc
items.summary: Aspiring rapper whose career CJ helps launch by stealing Madd Dogg's rhymes.

items.name: Ran Fa Li
items.summary: Senior Triad figure whose protection is a recurring obligation.

items.name: Salvatore Leone
items.summary: Liberty City don who owns Caligula's Palace and is targeted by the Triads.

items.name: Sean 'Sweet' Johnson
items.summary: CJ's older brother and the stubborn leader of Grove Street.

items.name: The Truth
items.summary: A hippie conspiracy theorist who supplies CJ with vehicles and information.

items.name: Wu Zi Mu ('Woozie')
items.summary: Blind Triad boss who becomes CJ's business partner in San Fierro and Las Venturas.

items.name: Zero
items.summary: RC hobbyist and electronics genius with a shop in San Fierro.

items.name: In the Beginning
items.summary: Opening: CJ returns to Los Santos and is picked up by Tenpenny and Pulaski.

items.name: Big Smoke
items.summary: Ride with Big Smoke and take out the Ballas chasing him.

items.summary: Rescue Sweet and his girlfriend from Ballas in a house shootout.

items.summary: Enter a low-rider hydraulic competition to win money for Sweet.
